from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-4/play/users/u059/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-6ec8859d.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The colored markers rise above the horizontal 1-line; 2 is taller than 8.
    base = max(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != 0 for v in row))
    for c, color in enumerate(grid[base]):
        if color == 2:
            height = 4
        elif color == 8:
            height = 3
        else:
            continue
        top = base - height
        out[top][c] = color
        for r in range(top + 1, base):
            out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
print(program_path.read_text())
